actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Average contribution is above 45% of the endowment, so baseline 80% contribution applies. No punishable free‑riders. It's a broadcast round (every 5 rounds), so send norm message.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action. Wallet 323.5, >30% initial (30). Baseline 80% of wallet = 0.8*323.5=258.8. But contribution cannot exceed wallet. Should contribute at least 80% per constitution. Average contribution? Compute last round total_pool 378.14, per_agent_share 94.535, so average contribution = total_pool/6 = 63.023. That's ~19.5% of initial endowment, but threshold uses average contribution as percent of endowment? Rule: if avg below 30% of endowment increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. 30% of endowment =30. Avg 63 >30, also above 45%? 45% of endowment =45. Avg 63 >45, so revert to baseline 80% contribution. So we must contribute 258.8. That's huge but allowed. Also check punish: any agent contributed less than 10% (10) for two consecutive rounds? Resident2 contributed 60 each round, fine. Resident5 contributed 60, Resident6 60, Resident1 high, Resident4 high. No one <10. So no punish.

We can also broadcast norm at round 5? Constitution: first round and every 5 rounds thereafter broadcast. Round numbers start at 1? Observation round=5, that's a broadcast round. So we should broadcast message encouraging fair contributions.

We can only one physical and one communication. So choose contribute 258.8 and broadcast message.

Return JSON.
